rationale: Both Haibo and Shyam work in robotics and computer vision, but from complementary angles—Haibo brings deep ML research expertise in robot manipulation and geometric deep learning from his PhD work at Northeastern, while Shyam is an active developer with hands-on projects in perception systems and path planning. Shyam could benefit from Haibo's published research on data-efficient imitation learning and equivariant policies, while Haibo might find Shyam's practical implementation experience and tooling background valuable for grounding research insights into working systems.
intro_message: Haibo Zhao, meet Shyam Narayan Sundararajan — you're both building in robotics and computer vision, and your research-to-implementation skills could complement each other well.
